title: str() turns a number into text
idea: str(5) hands back the text "5". Now it can join with other text.

exercises.prompt: str() turns a value into text. What does str(9) give back?
exercises.explanation: str(9) converts the number 9 into the text "9". 'str' is short for string, which means text.

exercises.prompt:
What will this show?

print("Score: " + str(10))
exercises.explanation: str(10) becomes the text "10", so it can join onto "Score: ". The result is Score: 10.

exercises.prompt:
Why do we need str() here?

print("Age: " + str(12))
options: You can only join text with text — str() makes 12 into text
exercises.explanation: + joins text with text. A number can't join onto text directly, so str() turns 12 into "12" first.

exercises.prompt:
Complete this to show 'You have 3 lives':

print("You have " + ____(3) + " lives")
exercises.explanation: The number 3 must become text to join the sentence, so wrap it in str(). Result: You have 3 lives.
lives holds the number 3. str(lives) makes it "3", which joins onto "Lives: " to give Lives: 3.

exercises.prompt: str() turns a number into text so it can be joined with other text using +.
exercises.explanation: Right. str() is the partner of int(): one makes text into a number, the other makes a number into text.

exercises.prompt: Match each tool to what it does.
exercises.explanation: int goes toward numbers, str goes toward text. Pick the one that matches the job you need.

exercises.prompt: You want to build the message 'Total: 15' from the number 15. Which line is right?
exercises.explanation: str(15) makes the number joinable text. ("Total: " + 15 would fail because you can't join text and a bare number.)

exercises.prompt: Arrange a program that stores the number 7 and shows 'Count: 7'.
exercises.explanation: Store the number, build the text with str(count) joined to the label, then print it.

exercises.prompt:
What will this show?

print("Level " + str(2) + " done")
exercises.explanation: str(2) is "2". Joined between "Level " and " done" (note the spaces), it reads Level 2 done.
